christian mccaffrey.headline: Wins Best Comeback Athlete
christian mccaffrey.summary: McCaffrey was named the Best Comeback Athlete at the 2026 ESPYS, Briana Jeannel of the 49ers' official site reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

rashee rice.headline: Poised to practice
rashee rice.summary: Rice (knee) has been cleared to practice ahead of training camp, Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

zay flowers.headline: Ravens keen on extension
zay flowers.summary: Ravens general manager Eric DeCosta said Thursday on 105.7 The Fan that Baltimore "definitely" wants to ink Flowers to a contract extension before the start of the 2026 regular season, Cordell Woodland of 105.7 The Fan Baltimore reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

trevor lawrence.headline: Draws praise for offseason work
trevor lawrence.summary: Lawrence has thrived in the early stages of his second offseason in head coach Liam Coen's system, John Shipley of SI.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

patrick mahomes.headline: Cleared for full practices
patrick mahomes.summary: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Friday that Mahomes (knee) has "been cleared to participate fully" to begin training camp, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

george kittle.headline: Starting training camp on PUP
george kittle.summary: The 49ers placed Kittle (Achilles) on the active/PUP list Saturday, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

hunter henry.headline: Remains top tight end
hunter henry.summary: While Henry returns as the Patriots' top tight end, slotting behind him on the team's depth chart has yet to be solidified following Julian Hill's season-ending knee injury, Evan Lazar of the team's official site reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

alvin kamara.headline: Agrees to new contract with Saints
alvin kamara.summary: Kamara and New Orleans agreed to terms Thursday on a restructured contract that gives him a $6 million base salary for the 2026 season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

brandon aiyuk.headline: Remains on left squad list
brandon aiyuk.summary: San Francisco general manager John Lynch told reporters Saturday that Aiyuk (knee) will remain on the 49ers' reserve/left squad list, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
